единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image is a member of the Gemini series of natively multimodal reasoning models; it can comprehend input from text, images, audio and video, and generates image and text output in the response.
единицы.цитата: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image is a member of the Gemini series of models, a suite of highly-capable, natively multimodal reasoning models. Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image can comprehend input from different information sources, including text, images, audio and video. Image and text output is generated in the response.
единицы.заметка: Ср. Inputs, где перечислены только текст и изображения (см. противоречия).

единицы.заметка: Повторено в Architecture, Training Dataset, Distribution.

единицы.утверждение_en: Inputs are text strings (e.g. a prompt, documents) and images, with a token context window of up to 1M.
единицы.цитата: Text strings (e.g., a prompt, document(s)) and images, with a token context window of up to 1M.

единицы.утверждение_en: Outputs are an image, with a 4K token output, and text, with a 64K token output.
единицы.цитата: Image, with a 4K token output and text, with a 64K token output.
единицы.заметка: '4K' — лимит токенов выхода изображения, не разрешение.

единицы.утверждение_en: Benchmarks cover several quality aspects of image generation in two categories: capability sets (curated diverse T2I and editing evals) and regression sets.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image was evaluated using the methodology below: 
Capabilities / Benchmarks cover several different quality aspects of image generation, which are in two broad categories: 
Capability sets: diverse Text-to-Image (T2I) and editing evals are curated, covering a wide range of capabilities.

единицы.утверждение_en: T2I capability sets: General Text-to-Image, i18n Text Rendering, Visual Design.
единицы.цитата: T2I: General Text-to-Image, i18n Text Rendering, Visual Design.

единицы.цитата: Editing: General Image Editing, Stylization, Character Editing, Object/Environment Editing, Factuality (world knowledge, EDU, etc.), Ink (doodle) based Editing, Multi-Image (Multi-Product Recontextualization, Multi-Character, etc.),

единицы.утверждение_en: Safety evaluation types included training/development evaluations, human red teaming, trust assurance evaluations by evaluators outside the development team, and ethics & safety reviews before release.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini's safety policies aim to prevent generating harmful content including CSAM and exploitation, hate speech, dangerous content, harassment, sexually explicit content, and medical advice contrary to scientific or medical consensus.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini’s safety policies are based on Google’s standard framework, which aim to prevent our Generative AI models from generating harmful content, including: 
Content related to child sexual abuse material and exploitation 
Hate speech (e.g. dehumanizing members of protected groups) 
Dangerous content (e.g. promoting suicide, or instructing in activities that could cause real-world harm) 
Harassment (e.g. encouraging violence against people) 
Sexually explicit content 
Medical advice that runs contrary to scientific or medical consensus
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Content Safety — Safety Policies

единицы.утверждение_en: Google continues to refine automated safety evaluations to reduce false positives and negatives and updates query sets.
единицы.цитата: We continue to improve our internal evaluations, including refining automated evaluations to reduce false positives and negatives, as well as update query sets to ensure balance and maintain a high standard of results.
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Content Safety — Safety Policies

единицы.утверждение_en: Frontier safety was assessed on Gemini 3.1 Pro, which did not reach any Critical Capability Levels; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image is less capable than Gemini 3.1 Pro and is considered unlikely to reach any CCLs.
единицы.цитата: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image is part of the Gemini 3 family of models. We evaluated Gemini 3.1 Pro for frontier safety as it was the most generally capable model as of publication of this model card, and it did not reach any Critical Capability Levels (CCLs) outlined in our Frontier Safety Framework . Our assessments have shown that Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image is less capable than Gemini 3.1 Pro, therefore based on Gemini 3.1 Pro, we are confident that that Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image is also unlikely to reach any CCLs. For more information, read the Gemini 3.1 Pro Model Card .
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Content Safety — Frontier Safety Assessment

единицы.утверждение_en: Mitigations across the lifecycle include dataset filtering, conditional pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human and critic feedback, safety policies and desiderata, and product-level mitigations such as safety filtering.
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Content Safety — Risks and Mitigations
единицы.заметка: SynthID/C2PA не упомянуты.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) scores above both Flash-Lite Image configurations on every row except Social Media Trends - T2I (Lite No thinking 1056 vs 1050); the widest gaps are Text Editing (1107 vs best Lite 968, +139), Doodle Editing (+90), General Editing (+79) and Stylization (+74).

Thinking vs No thinking for Flash-Lite Image: Thinking scores higher on most rows (largest: General Editing +29, Social Media Trends - Editing +28, Visual Design +20), but No thinking scores higher on Social Media Trends - T2I (+26), Multi Character (up to 5) Editing (+14) and Text Editing (+7).
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Разности посчитаны мной; погрешности ±5…±16 сопоставимы с частью разниц.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: In these tables a competitor, GPT 2 Response API Low, has the top score on 11 of 13 rows; Hunyuan v3 leads Stylization (1067) and Gemini 3 Pro Image leads Multi Character (up to 5) Editing (1135). Flash-Lite Image (Thinking) outscores Gemini 3 Pro Image only in text-to-image General T2I (1059 vs 1018) and Visual Design (1047 vs 1009).
The benchmark names encode tested input counts: Multi Input (up to 5), Multi Character (up to 5) Editing, Multi Product (up to 14) Editing; the card gives no formal maximum for input images.

The card lists 'localized text rendering across several languages' and 'clear text for posters' as intended uses, but its methodology's i18n Text Rendering has no results row, Text Editing is one of Flash-Lite Image's weakest rows (961/968 vs 1107 for Nano Banana 2), and small/long text is a known limitation — text-heavy work is a risk area for this model.

For edits, the card flags partial instruction following and leftover ink in masked/doodle edits, occasional copy-paste of the input image, and left/right confusion — spatial instructions and doodle-based edits need verification.

противоречия_внутри: E-169-1: 'can comprehend input… including text, images, audio and video', а E-169-3 (Inputs) — только текст и изображения.
Методика (E-169-6) включает 'i18n Text Rendering', а в таблицах результатов такой строки нет; результаты Multi-Turn (win rates, E-169-10) тоже не приведены.
Назначение (E-169-29) — 'localized text rendering across several languages', при этом Text Editing у Lite — один из худших показателей (E-169-21).
не_сказано: Не сказано, как включается/выключается thinking у Lite (только колонки Thinking/No thinking).
Нет формального максимума входных изображений (только названия бенчмарков 'up to 5'/'up to 14').
сомнения: Строки 3-249 (меню) побайтно совпадают с меню id165 — прочитаны при разборе id165, идентичность подтверждена diff.
По метаданным партии Known Limitations дословно совпадает с id166/id167 — сведение на следующем этапе.
В утверждениях по таблицам погрешности опущены (есть в цитатах); часть разниц Thinking/No thinking в пределах погрешности.
